title: Integrate upstream mimo-adapter into SIMA as a Git submodule
summary: Create a tracked submodule entry for the upstream mimo-adapter repository inside the SIMA project so other agents can clone/check out the dependency as part of the same stack.
objectives: Identify or confirm the upstream repository URL and branch for the mimo-adapter service
Add the service as a Git submodule under the SIMA project root or a dedicated services/ directory
Document the integration contract, expected network alias, and startup instructions
Ensure the compose stack can reference the service via the expected hostname and port
Provide a handoff note for other agents so they can validate and wire the adapter into the chat stack
acceptance_criteria: A git submodule entry exists in the repo for the mimo-adapter service
The submodule path is recorded and usable by agents without manual guesswork
Follow-up instructions explain how to initialize/update the submodule and wire it to Docker/SIMA
No secrets or private credentials are committed
The task is discoverable in the project coordination state
notes: This task is intentionally created to resolve the missing dependency: SIMA currently points to http://mimo-adapter:8000 but there is no corresponding service or repository in the current workspace.
The repository URL must be supplied by the project maintainer or discovered from the canonical upstream source before the submodule is added.
